profile_text.body:
Amazon is a for-profit public company founded in 1994 and headquartered in Seattle, Washington, United States, with amazon.com as its website. The text harvested from the company's own site contained no usable content, so there is no description of its business in its own words to report. No products are listed for the company in the product data.

Four MCP servers are listed in connection with Amazon. ai.sellermate/amazon-ads is described as letting a user ask an Amazon Ads account anything and act with guardrails, a remote MCP with OAuth that is free to connect. ai.trendsapi/amazon is described as covering Amazon product search volume and best-seller trends, with a free key at trendsapi.ai. ai.trendsmcp/amazon is described as covering Amazon product search demand over time, with growth for any keyword, and a free key at trendsmcp.ai. app.apiguru/amazon-data is described as providing live Amazon product, review, search, deal, offer/stock and seller data across 20 marketplaces. These are third-party integrations rather than Amazon products.

One case is listed in connection with the company, Haugland v. Anthropic PBC, in the District Court, D. Delaware. Law exposure is recorded for Washington, with a count of 102.
